# Scope: Volgan. Recomputes the values of zin_dominion_hosts from strength.
zin_volgan_refresh_strength = {
	set_variable = { zin_dominion_org = zin_dominion_strength }
	multiply_variable = { zin_dominion_org = 0.0015 }
	set_variable = { zin_dominion_morale = zin_dominion_strength }
	multiply_variable = { zin_dominion_morale = 0.002 }
	set_variable = { zin_dominion_recruit = zin_dominion_strength }
	multiply_variable = { zin_dominion_recruit = 0.005 }
	set_variable = { zin_dominion_training = zin_dominion_strength }
	multiply_variable = { zin_dominion_training = -0.002 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Any scope. Arguments: zin_arg_value, optional zin_arg_exempt (1 skips the halving above 75: the Great Muster and Mirolon's fall). Gains above 75 are halved; after the body breaks the cap is 40 (section 1).
zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = zin_arg_value }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_t_gain value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 75 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = zin_arg_exempt value = 0 compare = equals }
				}
				divide_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = 2 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_exempt = 0 }
			add_to_variable = { zin_dominion_strength = zin_volgan_t_gain }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dominion_stirred }
				}
				clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength min = 0 max = 40 }
			}
			zin_volgan_refresh_strength = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_value. Adds to the veil, sets the global band mirror (0 Hidden, 1 Rumoured, 2 Suspected, 3 Seen) and fires each downward crossing once (section 2).
zin_volgan_add_veil = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_volgan_veil = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_volgan_veil_band = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 70 compare = less_than } } set_variable = { global.zin_volgan_veil_band = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 50 compare = less_than } } set_variable = { global.zin_volgan_veil_band = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 30 compare = less_than } } set_variable = { global.zin_volgan_veil_band = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 70 compare = less_than }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_70 }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_70
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = Y0Y
							original_tag = Y55
							zin_dominion_is_free_dead_realm = yes
						}
					}
					country_event = { id = zin_dominion.2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
				zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 50 compare = less_than }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_50 }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_50
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
				zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 30 compare = less_than }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_30 }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_30
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					news_event = { id = zin_dominion.4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
				zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_value. Capped at 75 on the Bend road; the gate pact begins at 70 (section 5).
zin_volgan_add_nether_pact = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_nether_pact = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_nether_pact min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_volgan_nether_bent
					check_variable = { var = zin_nether_pact value = 75 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = { zin_nether_pact = 75 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_nether_pact value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_gate_pact }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_volgan_gate_pact
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Arguments: zin_arg_target (-1 every member, otherwise a member), zin_arg_value.
zin_volgan_add_oath = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_arg_target value = -1 compare = equals } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y7T }
			Y7T = {
				add_to_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = zin_arg_value }
				clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y7U }
			Y7U = {
				add_to_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = zin_arg_value }
				clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y10 }
			Y10 = {
				add_to_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = zin_arg_value }
				clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		var:zin_arg_target = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: Volgan. Every grave muster counts and stops the veil from recovering for 30 days.

	set_country_flag = { flag = zin_volgan_mustered days = 30 }
}

# Any scope. Arguments: zin_arg_count, zin_arg_where (0 Nafeher, otherwise a state). Creates the "Grave Host" template if missing, then the divisions inside the state's scope.
zin_volgan_spawn_grave_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Grave Host" } }
				division_template = {
					name = "Grave Host"
					division_names_group = ZIN_HOSTS_GRAVE_HOSTS
					regiments = {
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 0 y = 0 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 1 y = 0 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 0 y = 1 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 1 y = 1 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 0 y = 2 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 1 y = 2 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 0 y = 3 }
						zin_the_dead_revenant = { x = 1 y = 3 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_left = zin_arg_count }
			while_loop_effect = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_t_left value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_left = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_arg_where value = 0 compare = equals } }
					random_state = {
						limit = { zin_is_site_nafeher = yes }
						create_unit = {
							division = "name = \"Grave Host\" division_template = \"Grave Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.7"
							owner = Y8D
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					var:zin_arg_where = {
						create_unit = {
							division = "name = \"Grave Host\" division_template = \"Grave Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.7"
							owner = Y8D
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Two Abyss Host divisions at Nafeher; the sub-unit is unlocked first (section 10).
zin_volgan_spawn_abyss_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			unlock_subunit = zin_abyss_folk
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Abyss Host" } }
				division_template = {
					name = "Abyss Host"
					division_names_group = ZIN_HOSTS_GRAVE_HOSTS
					regiments = {
						zin_abyss_folk = { x = 0 y = 0 }
						zin_abyss_folk = { x = 1 y = 0 }
						zin_abyss_folk = { x = 0 y = 1 }
						zin_abyss_folk = { x = 1 y = 1 }
						zin_abyss_folk = { x = 0 y = 2 }
						zin_abyss_folk = { x = 1 y = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
			random_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_nafeher = yes }
				create_unit = {
					division = "name = \"Abyss Host\" division_template = \"Abyss Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.7"
					owner = Y8D
					count = 2
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_volgan_abyss_host_spawned
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_target. A capitulated realm becomes Volgan's vassal; an annexed one is released as one, in the Sworn Realm autonomy (section 9).
zin_volgan_make_client = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = var:zin_arg_target }
		Y8D = { puppet = var:zin_arg_target }
	}
	else = {
		Y8D = { release_puppet = var:zin_arg_target }
	}
	Y8D = { set_autonomy = { target = var:zin_arg_target autonomy_state = zin_autonomy_sworn_realm } }
}

# Helper for the Volgan tree: every Dark Lands country at pact 1 is offered the Pact of Spoils.
zin_volgan_tree_offer_spoils = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
			check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 1 compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_volgan_offer_level = 2 }
		country_event = { id = zin_dominion.8 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_target (-2 every orc or troll Dark Lands country, otherwise one country). Sends the envoys' offer (section 7).
zin_volgan_court_dark_lands = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_arg_target value = -2 compare = equals } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
				zin_dominion_is_bound_by_the_dead = yes
				NOT = { is_subject_of = Y8D }
				NOT = { has_war_with = Y8D }
			}
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_offer_level = 1 }
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.8 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		var:zin_arg_target = {
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_offer_level = 1 }
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.8 }
		}
	}
}

# Helper for the Volgan tree: the one offer of the Black Compact (decision O4).
zin_volgan_tree_offer_compact = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_black_compact }
			country_exists = Y0U
		}
		Y0U = { country_event = { id = zin_dominion.14 } }
	}
}

# Any scope. Volgan has declared war on Mirolon: the surprise spirits, the members called into the war, the events (sections 2 and 9).
zin_dominion_war_started = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_patience_of_ages }
					add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_dominion_out_of_the_storms days = 180 }
				}
				else = {
					add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_dominion_out_of_the_storms days = 120 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
					Y0Y = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_passes value = 60 compare = less_than } }
							add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_dominion_caught_unready days = 90 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 30 compare = less_than } }
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
					Y0Y = {
						add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_dominion_forewarned days = 180 }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = Y7T
					Y7T = { NOT = { has_war_with = Y0Y } }
					OR = {
						Y7T = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						Y8D = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_war_council }
					}
				}
				Y7T = {
					add_to_war = {
						targeted_alliance = Y8D
						enemy = Y0Y
						hostility_reason = asked_to_join
						single_target_only = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = Y7U
					Y7U = { NOT = { has_war_with = Y0Y } }
					OR = {
						Y7U = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						Y8D = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_war_council }
					}
				}
				Y7U = {
					add_to_war = {
						targeted_alliance = Y8D
						enemy = Y0Y
						hostility_reason = asked_to_join
						single_target_only = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = Y10
					Y10 = { NOT = { has_war_with = Y0Y } }
					OR = {
						Y10 = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						Y8D = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_war_council }
					}
				}
				Y10 = {
					add_to_war = {
						targeted_alliance = Y8D
						enemy = Y0Y
						hostility_reason = asked_to_join
						single_target_only = yes
					}
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		Y0Y = {
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.10 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Mirolon has fallen: flag, strength +10, oaths +10, Gathering Dark +5, the news (section 9).
zin_dominion_mirolon_falls = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_mirolon_fallen } }
		set_global_flag = zin_mirolon_fallen
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
			Y8D = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_exempt = 1 }
				zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_target = -1 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
				zin_volgan_add_oath = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_dominion.11 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Mirolon yielded: its court goes into exile when the Exile Court is built, in Herez, else Aenor, else the Gala Elves; the fall is recorded (section 9).
zin_dominion_mirolon_capitulated = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		Y0Y = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_mirolon_exile_ready }
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = Y55
						NOT = { Y55 = { has_war_with = Y8D } }
					}
					become_exiled_in = { target = Y55 legitimacy = 60 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						any_country = {
							zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
							NOT = { has_war_with = Y8D }
						}
					}
					random_country = {
						limit = {
							zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
							NOT = { has_war_with = Y8D }
						}
						save_event_target_as = zin_dominion_exile_host
					}
					become_exiled_in = { target = event_target:zin_dominion_exile_host legitimacy = 60 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { country_exists = Y6X }
					become_exiled_in = { target = Y6X legitimacy = 60 }
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_dominion.24 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { zin_volgan_mirolon_taken = yes }
		zin_dominion_mirolon_falls = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. A cause of war on the country that holds Parim, and the declaration (section 10).
zin_volgan_wargoal_parim = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_parim = yes }
					NOT = { original_tag = Y8D }
				}
				save_event_target_as = zin_dominion_parim_holder
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_dominion_parim_holder }
				create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = event_target:zin_dominion_parim_holder }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_dominion_parim_holder } }
					declare_war_on = { target = event_target:zin_dominion_parim_holder type = annex_everything }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Section 10: the march north.
zin_volgan_begin_march = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			set_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -100 }
			zin_volgan_add_veil = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				news_event = { id = zin_dominion.12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = Y55 }
				create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = Y55 }
			}
			zin_volgan_wargoal_parim = yes
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 3 compare = equals }
				}
				add_to_faction = Y8D
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 2 compare = equals }
				}
				give_military_access = Y8D
			}
			if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_veil_of_storms } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_veil_of_storms }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_storm_rites } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_storm_rites }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_abyss_march }
				zin_volgan_spawn_abyss_host = yes
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_tributary_friend }
				country_event = { id = zin_dominion.28 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Section 10: every sworn Dark Lands country claims a Dondor state next to it, or earns experience.
zin_volgan_raise_northern_front = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
					check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 3 compare = equals }
				}
				give_military_access = Y8D
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = Y19 any_neighbor_country = { original_tag = Y19 } }
					random_state = {
						limit = { controller = { original_tag = Y19 } }
						add_claim_by = PREV
					}
					create_wargoal = { type = take_claimed_state target = Y19 }
				}
				else = {
					army_experience = 20
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Section 10: Volgan takes the field (the engine never kills generals; only zin_volgan_destroy_body removes the role).
zin_volgan_take_field = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			add_field_marshal_role = {
				character = zin_volgan
				skill = 6
				attack_skill = 6
				defense_skill = 4
				planning_skill = 4
				logistics_skill = 3
				traits = { zin_trait_great_spirit_in_arms }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. "Then we break them too": Volgan declares on Zol over a claimed state (no annexation goal). The pulse sets zin_volgan_zol_clash.
zin_volgan_strike_zol = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = Y0U
					NOT = { has_war_with = Y0U }
				}
				random_state = {
					limit = {
						controller = { original_tag = Y0U }
						any_neighbor_state = { controller = { OR = {
									original_tag = Y8D
									is_subject_of = Y8D
								} } }
					}
					add_claim_by = Y8D
				}
				create_wargoal = { type = take_claimed_state target = Y0U }
				declare_war_on = { target = Y0U type = take_claimed_state }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The compact ends when the body breaks or Zol withdraws; neither side declares war on the other (section 11).
zin_dominion_end_compact = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_dominion_compact_active = yes }
		set_global_flag = zin_black_compact_ended
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
			Y8D = {
				diplomatic_relation = { country = Y0U relation = military_access active = no }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_two_darks } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_two_darks }
				country_event = { id = zin_dominion.23 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0U }
			Y0U = {
				diplomatic_relation = { country = Y8D relation = military_access active = no }
				country_event = { id = zin_dominion.23 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The first duel, Volgan's side (section 12); called by zin_dominion.16.

}

# Scope: a member. It goes its own way when the body breaks (section 4); called by zin_dominion.18 and by the AI rule of zin_volgan_destroy_body.
zin_dominion_member_breaks_free = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_member = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { is_subject_of = Y8D }
		Y8D = { end_puppet = var:zin_volgan_t_member }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = Y8D }
		leave_faction = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The Steward lets Mirolon go: white peace and its cores back (section 12); called by zin_dominion.19.
zin_dominion_let_mirolon_go = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = Y0Y
					has_war_with = Y0Y
				}
				white_peace = Y0Y
			}
			every_state = {
				limit = {
					is_core_of = Y0Y
					controller = { OR = {
							original_tag = Y8D
							is_subject_of = Y8D
						} }
				}
				transfer_state_to = Y0Y
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The Steward holds what was taken; the cores of Mirolon rise (section 12); called by zin_dominion.19.
zin_dominion_hold_mirolon = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			every_state = {
				limit = {
					is_core_of = Y0Y
					controller = { original_tag = Y8D }
				}
				add_resistance = 15
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Sets the Steward's ideology and the Silent Throne (section 12).
zin_volgan_steward_rule = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
		Y8D = {
			add_country_leader_role = {
				character = zin_volgan_ember_herald
				promote_leader = yes
				country_leader = {
					ideology = zin_shadow_dread
					expire = "1965.1.1.1"
					traits = { zin_trait_dread_lord }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_volgan_silent_throne
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = zin_dominion_silent_throne } }
				add_ideas = zin_dominion_silent_throne
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The body breaks (section 12): the leader roles are removed (he is not killed), the Steward rules, the hosts reel, the members are tested, the compact ends. A second call does nothing.
zin_volgan_destroy_body = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed } }
		set_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_dominion.17 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
			Y8D = {
				remove_country_leader_role = { character = zin_volgan ideology = zin_shadow_dread }
				remove_unit_leader_role = { character = zin_volgan }
				zin_volgan_steward_rule = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 25 compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { zin_dominion_strength = 25 } }
				clamp_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength min = 0 max = 40 }
				zin_volgan_refresh_strength = yes
				damage_units = { limit = { original_tag = Y8D } org_damage = 0.5 str_damage = 0.25 ratio = yes army = yes }
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_dominion_broken_host days = 365 }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_host_of_first_age } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_host_of_first_age }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_one_dominion } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_one_dominion }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_gates_opened } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_gates_opened }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_two_darks } remove_ideas = zin_volgan_two_darks }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_target = -1 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -30 }
				zin_volgan_add_oath = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y7T }
			if = {
				limit = { Y7T = { is_ai = no } }
				Y7T = { country_event = { id = zin_dominion.18 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { Y7T = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 40 compare = less_than } } }
				Y7T = { zin_dominion_member_breaks_free = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y7U }
			if = {
				limit = { Y7U = { is_ai = no } }
				Y7U = { country_event = { id = zin_dominion.18 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { Y7U = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 40 compare = less_than } } }
				Y7U = { zin_dominion_member_breaks_free = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y10 }
			if = {
				limit = { Y10 = { is_ai = no } }
				Y10 = { country_event = { id = zin_dominion.18 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { Y10 = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 40 compare = less_than } } }
				Y10 = { zin_dominion_member_breaks_free = yes }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
				check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			add_to_variable = { zin_volgan_pact = -2 }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact min = 0 max = 3 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		zin_dominion_end_compact = yes
		if = {
			limit = { zin_mirolon_occupied = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
				Y8D = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = yes }
						random_list = {
							90 = { zin_dominion_let_mirolon_go = yes }
							10 = { zin_dominion_hold_mirolon = yes }
						}
					}
					else = {
						country_event = { id = zin_dominion.19 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
			Y8D = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = yes }
					every_enemy_country = {
						limit = { NOT = { zin_dominion_is_ember_lands_country = yes } }
						country_event = { id = zin_dominion.26 days = 30 }
					}
				}
				mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
			Y0Y = {
				mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y7T }
			Y7T = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y7U }
			Y7U = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y10 }
			Y10 = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Raises the bunker level of the pass states Mirolon controls to floor(passes / 20) + 1, up to 6, one level at a time; forts are never removed (section 8).
zin_mirolon_raise_pass_forts = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		Y0Y = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_mirolon_t_level = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_mirolon_t_cut = 20 }
			while_loop_effect = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_passes value = zin_mirolon_t_cut compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_t_level value = 6 compare = less_than }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_mirolon_t_level = 1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_mirolon_t_cut = 20 }
			}
			while_loop_effect = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_fort_level value = zin_mirolon_t_level compare = less_than } }
				add_to_variable = { zin_mirolon_fort_level = 1 }
				every_state = {
					limit = {
						zin_is_site_mirolon_passes = yes
						controller = { original_tag = Y0Y }
					}
					add_building_construction = {
						type = bunker
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
						province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_border = yes }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_value.
zin_mirolon_add_passes = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		Y0Y = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_mirolon_passes = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_passes min = 0 max = 100 }
			zin_mirolon_raise_pass_forts = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_value (doubled while the veil is below 50). Fires the thresholds 25, 50 and 75 once each (section 8).
zin_mirolon_add_proof = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		Y0Y = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_mirolon_t_gain = zin_arg_value }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_t_gain value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					check_variable = { var = global.zin_volgan_veil_band value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_mirolon_t_gain = 2 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { zin_mirolon_proof = zin_mirolon_t_gain }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_proof min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_proof value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_mirolon_proof_25 }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_mirolon_proof_25
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							original_tag = Y55
							zin_dominion_is_free_dead_realm = yes
						}
					}
					country_event = { id = zin_dominion.3 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_proof value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_mirolon_proof_50 }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_mirolon_proof_50
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_proof value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_mirolon_proof_75 }
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_mirolon_proof_75
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_mirolon_unheeded_warnings } remove_ideas = zin_mirolon_unheeded_warnings }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
				zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
				zin_volgan_add_veil = yes
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					news_event = { id = zin_dominion.27 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Send Scouts South: proof +5 and veil -3; with the veil hidden, three scouting parties in ten are lost (proof +1, 10 Authority, veil unchanged) (section 8).
zin_mirolon_scout = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		Y0Y = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_volgan_veil_band value = 0 compare = equals } }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
						zin_mirolon_add_proof = yes
						add_political_power = -10
						country_event = { id = zin_dominion.6 }
					}
					70 = {
						set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
						zin_mirolon_add_proof = yes
						set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -3 }
						zin_volgan_add_veil = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
				zin_mirolon_add_proof = yes
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -3 }
				zin_volgan_add_veil = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Burn the Bridges: the roads of the pass states Mirolon controls are broken (section 8).

				limit = {
					zin_is_site_mirolon_passes = yes

			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The Hidden Mirolon: resistance in every Mirolon core state Volgan holds (section 8).
zin_mirolon_raise_resistance = {
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			is_core_of = Y0Y
			controller = { OR = {
					original_tag = Y8D
					is_subject_of = Y8D
				} }
		}
		add_resistance = 20
	}
}

# Any scope. Mirolon asks for its homes: the Steward is asked, or Mirolon takes a cause of war for its cores (section 8).
zin_mirolon_restore = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8D Y8D = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_silent_throne } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
			Y8D = {
				country_event = { id = zin_dominion.19 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0Y }
			Y0Y = {
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = Y8D }
					create_wargoal = { type = take_core_state target = Y8D }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
